en.text:
Passively grants #e${5+#d} Aim Assist, #e${15+#d} Airborne Effectiveness, and a #e${10+#g}% decreased ADS Animation Duration.

While no allies are within 15 meters:
Bonuses are increased to #e${10+#d} Aim Assist, #e${30+#f} Airborne Effectiveness, and a #e${20+#g}% decreased ADS Animation Duration.

enhanced (
var d = 1
var f = 2
var g = 5
#e Aim Assist bonus is increased by 1, Airborne Effectiveness bonus is increased by 1 (2 with no nearby allies), and the ADS Animation Duration is decreased by a further 5 percentage points.
)
